hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that handles all swap execution in beforeSwap: it takes input tokens from the pool manager, deposits them into Euler lending vaults, withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to settle accounting. Swaps are priced via a parameterizable concentrated-liquidity curve and validated against a reserve invariant on the Euler vault balances.
